project.name: AIOS context learning loops
project.identity: The AIOS file-backed learning-loop layer that turns prior work into governed reusable guidance.
project.audience: Operators and agents that need explicit lessons and retrieval rules without opaque memory mutation.
project.core_loop: Record a lesson, classify it, apply retrieval policy, and expose the resulting guidance with enough provenance to review.
project.north_star: Learning improves future context while remaining explicit, inspectable, and bounded by policy.
not_this: Treating every observed behavior as a lesson

scope.purpose: Maintain the contract layer for lessons, taxonomy, retrieval policy, examples, and bounded inner and outer learning loops.
scope.boundary: Owns aios/context-loops contracts and retrieval examples; task packet compilation, dashboard projection, and general storage operations remain outside this child.
non_goals: Treating every observed behavior as a lesson
